svg.title: Order of the hooks that decide where a WooCommerce extension may run its code
svg.desc: A vertical timeline of one page request on WordPress 7.1.3 with WooCommerce 11.2.1. First the plugin files are loaded; at that moment the WooCommerce class does not exist yet for a plugin whose directory sorts before woocommerce. Then plugins_loaded fires, where the extension checks that WooCommerce exists and starts. Then woocommerce_loaded, after_setup_theme and init. Inside init, before_woocommerce_init fires, the only moment to declare feature compatibility, followed by woocommerce_init, when the current user is known. The request ends with wp_loaded.
svg.text: One request, in the order the hooks fired on the test site
Recorded with a probe plugin that sorts before woocommerce; WooCommerce class check in the second column
